text.en: A 2015 profile names Aling Cely as the owner and main cook.
The same profile says it had served kinalas for more than three decades; it gives no exact opening year.
The eatery appeared on ABS-CBN’s Rated K in 2015.
FEATR’s 2023 account locates it on Dimasalang Street.
